is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles arabiensis and Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 5).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper discusses previous findings of kdr (L1014F/L1014S) and ace-1R in the background section (page 2), but does not report new genotype data for these or any other markers for the mosquitoes collected in this specific study.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper reports species identification (PCR) results (46 An. arabiensis out of 50 samples, page 5), but does not report genotype counts or frequencies for any insecticide-resistance markers.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in Asendabo, Ethiopia, using field-collected mosquitoes (page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an experimental hut trial conducted by the authors.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in Asendabo, Jimma Zone, Oromia Regional State, Ethiopia (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted from 16th November 2020 to 16th January 2021 (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new experimental hut trial.

supplement.evidence: No genotype data was collected, so no supplement is needed for this purpose.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the impact of combining IRS (pirimiphos-methyl) and ITNs (pyrethroid-only or PBO) in experimental huts in Ethiopia. While it reports species identification via PCR, it does not report any insecticide-resistance marker genotype data.
